cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-0/workspace/task && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
codes=[];invalid=[]
with open('scratch/log.jsonl','rb') as f:
    raw=f.read()
text=raw.decode('utf-8')
lines=text.split('\n')
if lines and lines[-1]=='': lines=lines[:-1]
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    if l.strip()=='' : continue
    try:
        o=json.loads(l)
    except Exception:
        invalid.append(i); continue
    if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get('level')=='error':
        codes.append(o.get('code'))
with open('scratch/errors.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({'codes':codes,'invalid_lines':invalid},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(codes,invalid)
EOF
cat scratch/errors.json; md5 scratch/log.jsonl
